div.div:
Browser observes the run through FastAPI
Authenticated fetch SSE: persisted stage / progress events
GET run: complete routes, allocations, costs and warnings
2.5-second polling watchdog; no automatic SSE reconnect loop
Blue = recommendation; purple = inspection; magenta = preview
Inspecting / animating a route does not change allocations

text.tspan: Browser observes the run through FastAPI
Authenticated fetch SSE: persisted stage / progress events
GET run: complete routes, allocations, costs and warnings
2.5-second polling watchdog; no automatic SSE reconnect loop
Blue = recommendation; purple = inspection; magenta = preview
Inspecting / animating a route does not change allocations

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(97, 97, 97), rgb(154, 154, 154));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 620px; height: 1px; padding-top: 855px; margin-left: 36px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Two concurrent runs; 180-second deadline; one API replica.
10 suppliers x 3 factories: up to 30 reachable pairs / 60 routes.
Cold maximum: 91 upstream HTTP calls before retries.
Matrix transactions are billed by cells, not just HTTP requests.
No durable queue, fleet dispatch, carrier quotes or live vehicle tracking.

text.tspan: Two concurrent runs; 180-second deadline; one API replica.

No durable queue, fleet dispatch, carrier quotes or live vehicle tracking.

div.div:
Current defaults from infra/main.tfvars.json. Cache/signature and persisted document kinds reflect implementation, not the original planning sketch.
Routing duration includes traffic. ETA adds only weather and simulated delays. Unavailable weather / unpriced tolls remain explicit warnings.
The browser talks only to FastAPI and authorized Maps tiles; it never reads Cosmos directly. TTL is asynchronous cleanup, not a backup or spending cap.

text.tspan: Current defaults from infra/main.tfvars.json. Cache/signature and persisted document kinds reflect implementation, not the original planning sketch.
Routing duration includes traffic. ETA adds only weather and simulated delays. Unavailable weather / unpriced tolls remain explicit warnings.
The browser talks only to FastAPI and authorized Maps tiles; it never reads Cosmos directly. TTL is asynchronous cleanup, not a backup or spending cap.
